event.eventInstantBasis: The Guardian reports that Tyson entered the ring at 9am on 11 February 1990 in its contemporary Tokyo fight reconstruction. This calibration fixes that reported local instant at 09:00 Asia/Tokyo; it is not represented as an independently verified bell time.

pregame.marketContext: The Guardian documents Douglas as the 42-to-1 underdog. The World Boxing Council independently describes Tyson as the overwhelming favorite in the Tokyo Dome bout.
